Institute of Drafting Technologists
Sri Lanka (Incorporation)
and  all  contracts,  agreements,  assets  and  property  of  the
Institute  existing  on  the  day  preceding  the  date  of
commencement of this Act shall be deemed to be contracts,
agreements, assets and property of the Body Corporate under
and for the purpose of this Act.

18.
If upon the dissolution of the Body Corporate, there
remains any property whatsoever, after the satisfaction of all
debts and liabilities, such property shall not be distributed
among  the  members  of  the  Body  Corporate,  but  shall  be
given or transferred to some other institution or institutions
having objects similar to those of the Body Corporate and
which is or are by its rules prohibited from distributing any
income  or  property  among  its  or  their  members.  Such
institution or institutions may be determined by the members
of the Body Corporate on or before the dissolution of the
Body Corporate.
19. Nothing contain in this Act shall prejudice or affect
the rights of the Republic and any body politic or corporate
of any other persons except such as are mentioned in this
Act, and those claiming by from or under them.

20.
In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala
and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
